_doc: Shared model/token budget policy for dashboard Chat, Hermes profiles, and future agent swarms. Free-first; paid only when free rate-limits, refuses, or fails. Do NOT re-add tencent/hy3:free (OpenRouter sunset 2026-07-21).

providers._doc: Selectable inference providers. Default (unprefixed model id) = openrouter. Route via ZenMux with a `zenmux:<slug>` model-id prefix (dashboard maps it to `hermes --provider zenmux -m <slug>`; Hermes reads providers.zenmux from each profile config.yaml). Adding zenmux does not change default chains.

zenmux.note: OpenAI-compatible; OpenRouter-style slugs (openai/gpt-5, qwen/qwen3-max). Set ZENMUX_API_KEY in ~/.hermes/.env to enable. Use with the zenmux: prefix, e.g. zenmux:moonshotai/kimi-k3-free. ZenMux free variants use a -free slug suffix (NOT OpenRouter's :free).

known_models._source: Captured from ZenMux picker screenshot 2026-07-18 (partial list — not exhaustive; ZenMux catalog is larger, verify live via discover_models).

ops.note: Dashboard Chat + think/code/meta. Raise live key via OpenRouter UI or set-openrouter-key-limit.sh + MANAGEMENT key.

free.note: Platform hard caps still apply (20 RPM; 50 or 1000 RPD). :free models can 429 at $0.

tencent/hy3:free.note: Removed from primary chains — do not re-add.
